name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
summary: At sacred stones in Mulgore and Durotar, Minor Manifestation of Earth waits unseen. Fledgling shamans who drink Earth Sapta can meet the spirit and receive rough quartz for carving their first earth totem.

sections.title: Voice of the Stone
sections.body: Earth spirits dwell beneath dirt and stone, but reaching them takes a deliberate rite. At Kodo Rock in Mulgore and Spirit Rock in Durotar, Minor Manifestations of Earth linger beyond ordinary sight, surrounded by lesser elemental presences. Only initiates who drink Earth Sapta, a draught brewed by shamanic mentors, can cross the veil between the physical world and the elements. When an initiate makes contact, the spirit grants the earth's blessings and a piece of rough quartz. The novice can use it as the spiritual focus for making an Earth Totem.

faq.q: Why can't I see the Minor Manifestation of Earth?
faq.answer: Minor Manifestation of Earth remains unseen by ordinary sight on the elemental plane. Drink Earth Sapta from your shaman trainer to perceive and speak with elemental spirits.

faq.q: Where can these earth spirits be found?
aliases: where to find manifestation of earth
faq.answer: These earth spirits appear at Kodo Rock in Mulgore and Spirit Rock in Durotar. Both places are traditional proving grounds for young tauren, orc, and troll shamans.

faq.q: What is the spirit's purpose during the rite?
faq.answer: The manifestation tests and acknowledges your bond with the earth element. After you speak with it, the spirit gives you rough quartz to take back to your shaman trainer for making an Earth Totem.

faq.q: What are the smaller creatures surrounding it?
faq.answer: Lesser manifestations of earth gather around the central spirit. They are minor echoes of the element drawn to the sacred grounds, part of the natural communion, and cannot be directly engaged.

angles.text: As a young Horde shaman, you commune with Minor Manifestation of Earth under the influence of Earth Sapta to earn your first totem.
As a young tauren, you travel east across Mulgore to Kodo Rock to commune with this manifestation as part of your ancestral spiritual trials.
